scope: SSE/SZSE full-session market and security-status facts
full_day: Empty suspend_timing retains the existing full-day S semantics.
partial_day: An explicit HH:MM-HH:MM interval strictly shorter than the 09:30-15:00 session can coexist with a same-security/date daily bar only when that bar proves positive traded volume. Preserve the daily bar; is_suspended remains the full-day flag, false. security_status normal_active means a valid traded daily observation.
failure: Malformed timing, full-session timing, missing daily evidence or nonpositive daily volume remains unsupported and fails closed.
raw: Both supplier payloads remain unchanged and bound through ordered Raw refs; timing is not rewritten into a full-day event.
qualification: best_effort terminal supplier evidence; no verified intraday PIT claim
